paper.title: DM0.5: An Open-World Foundation Model for General-Purpose Embodied Intelligence
paper.organization: Dexmal (原力灵机 / 重庆智能科技有限公司)

architecture.inference_speed: 10 Hz on RTX 4090, 20 Hz on H100

notes.scope: Complete bilingual reader and comprehensive technical report covering all sections of the Dexmal DM0.5 official release whitepaper.
notes.source_coverage: All sections from the HTML snapshot and extracted text are covered: Overview, Model (Context Abstraction Layer, Embodiment CoT Tasks, Trajectory Alignment Layer, Training, Inference), Data (Composition, Cleaning Strategy), Experiments (Zero-Shot Generalization, Fine-Tuning Capability on RoboChallenge Table30 v2 / LIBERO / RoboTwin2.0 / R2R & RxR Navigation, Historical Context Modeling, Policy Robustness under Camera Viewpoint & Human Perturbations), Conclusion, Organization & Ecosystem.
notes.paragraph_policy: Source prose is arranged into 59 strictly paired English/Chinese blockquotes with colored labels (> Para. X: / > Para. X[CN]:).
notes.asset_policy: All 10 available assets in assets/ (image_01.png ~ image_10.png) are linked locally with bilingual captions (**Caption:** / **Caption[CN]:**). All tables are transcribed into clean, searchable Markdown tables.
notes.identical_policy: paper.md is maintained as an exact byte-for-byte copy of detailed_paper.md.

blocks.summary: Frontmatter metadata, official publication banner, section index, and 18-term technical terminology ledger.
VLA evolution, DM0 foundation, open-world challenge, 5 core technical improvements, and 4 open-world task demonstration areas.
4B VLM backbone, 680M Action Expert, historical context fusion, and embodied reasoning.
60-second visual memory, temporal/spatial token sampling, and graceful fallback.
11 autoregressive embodied reasoning tasks across task planning, event prediction, and action intent.
Dynamic action matching, monotonic dynamic programming alignment, and trajectory continuity objective.
Multi-source mixture training, decoupled learning rates, action chunking, and 10Hz/20Hz inference throughput.
Heterogeneous dataset composition and 5-step data cleaning strategy.
Evaluation setup across 8 atomic actions and 7 condition constraints on Franka and Dexmal-Mirror platforms; Table 1 and Table 2.
SOTA 43% success rate and 54.42 composite score on real-robot tabletop manipulation.
SOTA results on LIBERO (99.0%), RoboTwin2.0 (93.5%), and R2R/RxR vision-language navigation benchmarks; Tables 3, 4, and 5.
Real-world short-horizon cup-and-table wiping and long-horizon battery demonstration learning.
Camera viewpoint robustness matrix across 9 configurations (Table 6) and dynamic adaptation under human perturbations.
Foundational open-world philosophy, robotic ecosystem, platforms, and corporate contact.
In-depth technical critique on architectural highlights, trajectory alignment, memory, and industrial deployment.
